note: Pre-registered before any sector score was computed and before any trade of the nine 'confirmation' groups was looked at. The sector-position pattern was SEEN on Trio Fortnightly and Four Sectors Monthly, No Tilt (BL-115 descriptive follow-up), so those two only describe it here and the verdict on it comes from the other nine groups. Never edit after a run; supersede with bl116_criteria_addendum_N.json.

questions.H1_sector_position: Do picks from the best-placed sector held (position 1) beat Nifty 500 more often than picks from the other fresh positions?
questions.H2_sector_score: Does the chosen sector's own average-weekly score at the decision week (the mean of its members' scores, each the sum over the strategy's lookbacks of return / weeks) separate the picks that beat Nifty 500 from those that did not?

H1_decides_on.note: every saved Broad group except the two below; each sleeve re-run with its saved config_full and end = 2022-12-30; settings fingerprints checked before the run

samples.H1_describes_only: trio_fortnightly and four_sectors_monthly_no_tilt as in bl115_criteria.json (already seen)

windows.caveat: All eleven groups were chosen on results that include 2017-2026; the nine groups share many sectors and stocks with the two, so they are not independent evidence, only unseen trades

trades.which: every new position (engine BUY) filled from 2017-01-06 and closed by 2022-12-30, as in BL-115; positions open at the end excluded and counted
trades.decision_week: the week whose ranks chose the stock: the fill week minus the sleeve's signal_delay weeks
trades.stocks_only: non-stock picks (Gold, Silver, Nasdaq 100, Hang Seng and any other ATOMIC_NAMES) are excluded from both tests and counted: judging a diversifier against an equity index says nothing about the sector
trades.sector: the category the engine bought the stock through (BroadBacktestResult.effective.groups at the decision week)
trades.sector_position: the category's place in that week's held list, best first (BroadBacktestResult.held_by_week). Only fresh positions 1..category_top_n are tested; a pick from a lingering position is excluded and counted

outcome.excess: the position's return (position_return) minus Nifty 500 TRI's return from the fill week to the exit week

H1_rule.per_group: beat rate of position-1 picks minus beat rate of picks from positions 2..category_top_n
H1_rule.pass: the difference is above zero in at least 7 of the 9 groups AND, over the nine groups' trades together, it is at least 5 percentage points with a 90% block-bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples of decision weeks, seed 116) entirely above zero

H2_sector_score.definition: at the decision week d, for each member of the chosen category that is in the point-in-time universe that week (UniverseRanking.stock_membership true for its live column) and has prices back to the longest lookback: sum over the strategy's lookbacks k of (p[d] / p[d-k] - 1) / k, in percent; the sector score is the mean over those members (at least 3, else missing)
H2_sector_score.members: categories.broad.load_stock_groups(curated, dated=True): the curated tags these sleeves run on

H2_rule.a_rank_correlation: Spearman rho between the sector score and the trade's excess; t = rho / standard deviation over 2,000 block-bootstrap resamples of decision weeks (seed 116); holds when rho > 0 and t >= 3
H2_rule.b_losers_in_worst_fifth: the trades in the lowest fifth of sector scores (cut points from that strategy's own trades) have a loser share at least 10 percentage points above the strategy's overall loser share
H2_rule.pass: a and b both hold in BOTH strategies

report_only: H1 on Trio and Four Sectors (already seen), by position 1, 2, 3 ...
H1 mean excess and worst-20% share by position, per group
H2 within the same week: the sector score relative to the other held sectors' scores that week against the excess
H2 alongside sector position: the score's rank correlation inside each position
the sector's score against the stock's own score (BL-115 F0): correlation
look_ahead_check: a test recomputes the sector score with every price after d removed and requires the same value; nothing after 2022-12-30 is read
will_not_run: other lookbacks or weights for the score
a tuned threshold or a change to the engine (a later phase, only if a hypothesis passes, under its own pre-registration)
